symbols.R: retained revision states processed by the history fill
symbols.S: verified current-closure or file bytes per revision
symbols.U_R: unique retained SQLite/CAS objects accumulated through R revisions

g5_3_complexity_precision.verified_history_fill: Theta(R*S) because each fill publication performs the Verified scrub for its current closure
g5_3_complexity_precision.current_root_work: Does not enumerate R; SQLite lookup may contribute O(log U_R) in addition to operation-local closure/path work
g5_3_complexity_precision.storage_and_gc_scope: Append-only retained storage remains; reachability is read-only and no destructive GC is claimed
